<div class="card-body">
'''Tauntaun''' is a [[Light]] [[Vehicle]] ([[Creature Vehicle]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">トーントーン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">乗客を1名乗せられる。ホス上にのみ配備できるが、それ以降はどこにでも移動させてもよい。能力値＝1/4。リアクションとして戦闘から移動して逃げることができる。犠牲にする（ロストさせる）ことによって、乗客をそのターンの間「凍死」の影響を受けないようにすることができる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Tauntaun-SWCA-100693.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ホスで最初に発見された土着生物。氷原を群れをなして移動する。気が短くて臆病。体表は猛烈な獣の臭いを放つ。反乱軍のパトロール用に飼いならされている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Tauntaun.

'''Card text:'''
May carry 1 passenger. May deploy only on Hoth, but may move anywhere after that. Ability equals 1/4. May move and flee from a battle as a reaction. You may sacrifice (lose) it to make the passenger immune to "freezing death" this turn.

'''Lore:'''
The first native creature found on Hoth. They travel the ice fields in herds. Short-tempered and timid. Their bodies give off a fierce animal smell. They have been tamed for Rebel patrols.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore describes a fierce animal smell and taming for patrols.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Tauntaun]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
